name: W Los Angeles, West Beverly Hills
insider_take: Where Hollywood glamour meets cutting-edge design in the heart of West Beverly Hills—this is where A-listers come to see and be seen.
whats_special: The W Los Angeles sits on the iconic Westwood Boulevard, just blocks from UCLA and minutes from Rodeo Drive. The hotel's signature BLISS Bar has hosted countless celebrity parties, while the rooftop pool offers stunning views of the Hollywood Hills. Fun fact: the hotel's lobby features original artwork from emerging LA artists, rotating quarterly to showcase the city's vibrant creative scene.
pro_tip: Book the pool cabanas on Thursday evenings when local DJs spin at the weekly "Wet" pool party—it's become legendary among LA's social circuit.
dont_miss: The hotel's "Whatever/Whenever" concierge service can arrange exclusive experiences like private shopping at nearby boutiques on Melrose or VIP access to comedy shows at the world-famous Comedy Store, just a 5-minute drive away. The Westwood Village Memorial Park Cemetery, final resting place of Marilyn Monroe, is also within walking distance for those seeking a piece of Hollywood history.
pros: Prime Beverly Hills location with easy access to Rodeo Drive and West Hollywood
Stylish modern design with signature W Hotels contemporary aesthetic
Rooftop pool and bar offering panoramic city views
Vibrant nightlife scene and trendy social atmosphere
cons: High-energy environment may not suit guests seeking quiet relaxation
Premium pricing typical of luxury Beverly Hills properties
